:::{#exm-pairwise-disjoint}
#### Low, middle and high die rolls

For the die rolls $D = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$ ([sets of die rolls](#exm-set)),
the sets $\set{1, 2}$, $\set{3, 4}$ and $\set{5, 6}$ are [pairwise disjoint](#def-pairwise-disjoint):
no roll is in more than one of them.
The sets $\set{1, 2}$, $\set{3, 4}$ and $\set{2, 5}$ are not,
because $2$ is in both the first and the third.

:::
